questions.clue:
Σᵢ xᵢ / n
for n observations
questions.explanation: Add the observed values and divide by their count.
questions.reference: Everitt and Skrondal (2010), 4th ed., p. 274, Mean

questions.explanation: Subtract the lower quartile from the upper quartile to find the span of the middle half.
questions.reference: Everitt and Skrondal (2010), 4th ed., p. 220, Interquartile range

questions.clue:
Σ (xᵢ − x̄)² / (n − 1)
where x̄ is the sample mean
questions.explanation: The sample variance divides the sum of squared deviations from the sample mean by n − 1.
questions.reference: Everitt and Skrondal (2010), 4th ed., p. 445, Variance

choices: Joint probability of A and B
questions.explanation: The conditional probability of A given B is the probability of A within B.
questions.reference: Everitt and Skrondal (2010), 4th ed., p. 98, Conditional probability. Formula also in MIT 18.05, Class 3, section 2, equation (1): https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/18-05-introduction-to-probability-and-statistics-spring-2022/mit18_05_s22_class03-prep.pdf

questions.clue: Order the five waiting times and report the third.
questions.explanation: With five ordered observations, the third observation is the middle one.
questions.reference: Everitt and Skrondal (2010), 4th ed., p. 275, Median

questions.clue: One shoe size outsold every other size this week. Which summary is that size?
questions.explanation: The mode is the value with the highest frequency.
questions.reference: Everitt and Skrondal (2010), 4th ed., p. 281, Mode

questions.clue: A plot of numerical intervals where each rectangle's area represents its frequency.
questions.explanation: Histogram rectangles cover numerical intervals, with areas proportional to how often observations fall in them.
questions.reference: Everitt and Skrondal (2010), 4th ed., p. 206, Histogram

questions.clue: Each point marks one subject's two numeric measurements, one on each axis.
questions.explanation: A scatterplot shows the joint pattern of two numeric measurements.
questions.reference: Everitt and Skrondal (2010), 4th ed., p. 379, Scatterplot
